# Daily Report — 2026-08-16

## Task Completed
Added `list_catalog_items_by_catalog` and `search_catalog_items` tools to provide
full-catalog item visibility across all categories.

**`list_catalog_items_by_catalog`** — scopes sc_cat_item results to a specific
service catalog (resolved by sys_id or title via `_resolve_catalog_sys_id`),
queries using `catalogsIN<catalog_sys_id>` so items belonging to multiple
catalogs are correctly captured, and returns each item with its category
display-value. Supports optional category filter (sys_id or substring name
match), text search, active filter, and has_more/next_offset pagination.

**`search_catalog_items`** — full-text cross-catalog search over item name and
short_description fields; each result includes catalog and category context so
callers can see exactly where each item lives without extra lookups. Supports
active filter and has_more/next_offset pagination.

**`_resolve_catalog_sys_id`** — private helper that passes 32-hex sys_ids
through unchanged and performs a titleLIKE lookup for non-hex values; returns
None on not-found or network error so callers can surface a clean failure message.

Both tools registered in `catalog_builder`, `service_desk`, and `full` packages.
35 new tests cover: params defaults and validation, resolver passthrough/lookup/
not-found/error, success with sys_id, success with name (two-call chain), empty
results, active filter on/off, query filter, category sys_id vs name filter,
catalog-not-found failure, network error, item field completeness, pagination
has_more detection (limit+1 sentinel), next_offset computation, and limit+1
being sent to the API.
